active_profile.checks: The allele-specific 3′ anchor is evaluated against the declared reference and alternate alleles, nearby masked variants and the selected terminal-mismatch evidence model. active_profile.guidance: Use this when a primer should match one allele at its 3′ end and discriminate against the other. A proposed near-terminal mismatch is a candidate-design aid, not proof of allele discrimination; paired wet-lab validation is still required.
active_profile.name: ARMS-PCR
active_profile.summary: Allele-specific primers whose 3′ end distinguishes two variant alleles.

Finite exclusion backgrounds are reviewed for orientation-invariant six-region LAMP-compatible topology with the declared <=2-substitution model; genome-scale backgrounds require indexed validation rather than being called clean.
Core-pair search-budget allocation is target-wide round-robin and all active truncation stages are surfaced; bounded runs do not claim a global optimum.
Unavailable pairwise structure evidence is represented as incomplete and cannot outrank a successfully computed low-risk interaction matrix merely because values are missing.

When pasted exclusion background exceeds the direct LAMP scope, the request fails closed before candidate-specific scanning; PCRStudio must not silently substitute a separately configured indexed database for user-supplied raw sequence.
MFEprimer ordered-molecule dimer/hairpin validation groups alternative LAMP candidates by lamp_set_index; oligos from different candidate sets are never pooled into one fictitious physical reaction.
intentional_boundaries: Core contract is four primers targeting six core regions; LF/LB are optional, yielding up to six oligos.
No in-silico rank, dimer score, background scan, or conservation panel is a wet-lab sensitivity/specificity guarantee.
The direct <=2-substitution topology matcher is ungapped and finite-background scoped; indel/polymerase-mediated nonspecific amplification remains outside that model.

Genome-scale specificity is an explicit indexed-database scope. Oversized pasted raw background is refused because its bases cannot be assumed equivalent to the configured database; indexed evidence cannot be represented as zero direct hits.
